A partial update. Only fields present in the request are changed.

Holding fields are re-validated as a whole after merging, so a PATCH can't
produce an invalid combination (e.g. switching to raw but keeping a grade).

post.description: Record 1-200 sales of this card (e.g. from a CSV). They count toward your comps and estimates only; other collectors never see them.

Queues a market sync for this card and returns the job; poll `/market/sync-jobs/{job_id}`, then reload comps. A sync already queued or running, or one that finished in the last 15 minutes, is returned instead of starting another.
Returns a presigned POST. Upload the file directly to storage, then call `.../images/{image_id}/complete`. The policy pins the key, content type, and size.
Verifies the stored file (size, type, signature, SHA-256) and makes it the card's front or back photo, replacing the previous one.
